answer: Walnut Delay Registry: an identity must complete a randomized sequence of live reasoning tasks whose total solve time is calibrated to a fixed minimum (e.g., 40 minutes), spread across unpredictable check-ins over hours. Missed check-ins reset progress to zero. The task stream is hollow of reusable answers, since each prompt is generated fresh and graded on process traces. An attacker running N sybils pays N times the wall-clock attention cost, capped by how many sessions one operator can genuinely supervise at the summit of their throughput.
